title: Snowy Hub | Auto Carry, Auto Res, Gravity Abuse & More
features:
Here is the list of features for Evade in plain text format:

MOVEMENT & PHYSICS FEATURES
- Player Speed: Sets your movement speed by modifying the game's internal config tables (Default: 1500).
- Player Jump: Sets your player's jump power (Default: 3.5).
- Player Jump Cap: Limits your maximum jump height to prevent over-jumping (Default: 1).
- Player Strafe Acceleration: Modifies air control acceleration for better movement while jumping (Default: 187).
- Apply Method: Allows you to choose between Optimized or Not Optimized logic for applying physics changes.
- CFrame Speed: A specialized speed hack that moves your character via CFrame manipulation.
- CFrame Speed Ratio: A slider to enter your desired speed ratio for the CFrame hack.
- OLD Speed: A legacy velocity-based speed hack used as an alternative to the table-based speed.
- Speed Ratio: A slider to adjust the intensity of the "OLD Speed" hack (Range: 80 to 500).
- Fly Hack: Enables the ability to fly through the air (Note: Script marks this as a Ban Risk).
- Fly Speed: Adjusts the speed at which you move while the Fly Hack is active.

AUTOMATION FEATURES
- Auto-Carry: Automates the process of carrying downed teammates to safety.
- Auto-Jump: Provides a mobile-optimized GUI for automatic jumping.
- Auto-Respawn: Automatically triggers a respawn event if your character is downed (2.25s delay).
- Toggle Speed: A dedicated tool designed to optimize "e-dashing" (fast dashing) mechanics.
- Toggle Gravity: Allows you to manipulate the game's gravity settings.

VISUAL & COSMETIC FEATURES
- ESP (Wallhack): Makes players visible through walls with color-coded highlights.
- Downed Detection: Part of ESP; turns player highlights Red and adds a "Down" tag when they are incapacitated.
- Alive Detection: Part of ESP; keeps player highlights Green while they are active.
- Emote Changer: Allows you to map Owned Emotes to Target Emotes, playing the target emote instead of the owned one.
- Apply Mappings: Activates your custom emote configurations.
- Reset All: Clears all current emote changer settings back to default.
